entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support! Ugh, just get me a person.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Don't waste my time, Isaac. I'm already furious about this.

I understand completely. Pulling up your order now... okay, I see it. And I see you're a VIP member with us. We appreciate your loyalty. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference to not use garbage! The whole menu system is **confusing**. It's so **hard to use**, I can't even get it to track a workout properly. I read the **user manual** twice! I **expected more** from a company like VeloFit. This is unacceptable. Put your manager on the phone.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak with a manager. I am empowered to resolve this for you directly. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
You'd better resolve it. I'm one click away from posting reviews about this experience on every website I can find.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your account. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 29 days ago. Looking at our return policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you'll take it back? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I am processing that return for you right now. You will receive a pre-paid shipping label to your email address on file within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method. And for the trouble this has caused, as a VIP member, I've also added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account.
Oh. A full refund and a fifty-dollar credit? ...Okay. Well, that's better. That's the kind of service I expect. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
